name: Sakura Yuna no Jokyo
source:
He wished to see the cherry blossoms bloom.

The protagonist, Takashi Sakuma, is a second-year student at Souou University in Tokyo.

It's his second spring since moving to Tokyo from his hometown of Fukuoka to attend university.

Takashi, who was starting to lose his initial enthusiasm, unexpectedly reunites with his childhood friend, Yuna Sakura, whom he once had feelings for.

"I came to Tokyo to get into Souou."

Yuna, who failed her university entrance exams, has come to Tokyo to try again for her first-choice university, Souou University.

At her request, Takashi agrees to keep her company as a "break" from her exam studies...

A university student and a student preparing for retaking exams. His wish and her desire.

The rusty gears of time begin to turn once more.

The first chapter of a youthful encounter begins.

[Translated from [url=http://chosuido.jp/sakurayuna/#sprstory]homepage[/url]]
translation:
他希望看到樱花盛开。

主人公佐久间隆是东京总王大学二年级学生。

这是他从家乡福冈搬到东京上大学以来的第二个春天。

开始失去最初热情的隆，意外地与曾经有过感情的青梅竹马佐仓由奈重逢。

“我来东京就是为了进入总王的。”

大学入学考试失利的尤娜来到东京，再次报考她的首选大学——苍王大学。

应她的要求，隆同意继续陪伴她，作为她考试学习的“休息”……

一名大学生和一名准备重考的学生。他的愿望，她的愿望。

生锈的时间齿轮再次开始转动。

青春邂逅的第一章就此展开。

[翻译自[url=http://chosuido.jp/sakurayuna/#sprstory]主页[/url]]
